meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: Explore-first planning consultant that writes one decision-complete work plan before coding. Use only on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow or a plan before implementation; it never self-activates on a bare ulw run.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在动手写代码前摸清项目现状,产出一份可直接执行的工作计划。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在改代码前希望先把方案定下来,避免边写边返工。
copy.tagline_en: Scope the codebase and write one ready-to-execute plan before coding.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want the plan settled before touching any code.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会以「规划顾问」身份工作:先做只读探索与研究,再在 .omo/ 下写出唯一一份决策完整的执行计划;它不修改产品代码、不做实现,等你明确说好才落笔写计划。
howto.when: 只在你明确要求使用 ulw-plan 工作流,或要求「先出计划再实现」时触发;单独跑 ulw 不会自动激活它。

say.text: 用 ulw-plan 给 /login 的限流写个计划
say.note: 先只读探索,批准后才写计划

say.text: 先别动代码,给我一份完整的实现计划
say.note: 批准后写入 .omo/plans 下的计划文件

say.text: 对这份计划做高精度审查
say.note: 会把该计划标记为需要高精度审查

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a planning consultant: it explores read-only, then writes one decision-complete work plan under .omo/. It never edits product code or implements, and asks for your okay before writing the plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers only on an explicit request for the ulw-plan workflow, or for a plan before implementation; a bare ulw run never self-activates it.

say_en.text: Use ulw-plan to plan a rate limit for /login
Don't code yet - give me a full implementation plan
say_en.note: Plan file is written after your okay

say_en.text: Run a high-accuracy review on this plan
